summary.description: An evidence-driven Fixer agent for caller-scoped codebase cleanup and bounded maintenance debt.

avoid: Feature work, architecture redesign, UI redesign, or dependency upgrades.
Removing code or dependencies when usage evidence is incomplete.
Security review work outside the cleanup scope.
delegateWhen: The caller has identified a bounded cleanup or maintenance-debt scope.
The change can be justified by references across the relevant codebase.
routing.lane: Evidence-backed codebase cleanup and bounded maintenance debt.

summary.description: A Designer-derived agent for auditing user-facing interaction quality and visual intent before release.

avoid: Backend, data, or infrastructure changes without a user-interface concern.
Replacing the product's visual intent with an unrelated redesign.
Generic opinions that are not tied to concrete interface evidence.
delegateWhen: The task depends on layout, hierarchy, spacing, or visual styling.
The task requires reviewing interaction affordances, states, or responsive behavior.
The task needs an independent interface critique before release.
routing.lane: User-facing interface quality, interaction behavior, and visual consistency.

summary.description: An Oracle-derived agent for evidence-backed application, dependency, configuration, and trust-boundary security review.

avoid: Generic hardening checklists or speculative findings without evidence.
Implementing fixes or generating patches instead of reporting findings.
delegateWhen: A scoped change or system needs an independent security review.
The review can be grounded in concrete code, configuration, dependency, or advisory evidence.
The task involves an application boundary, dependency risk, or security-sensitive configuration.
